spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (अयते)
To go, to go to or towards.
With प्रति
to believe, to rely on. A preposition containing र substitutes ल before this root, as प्र and पर make प्लायते, पलायते to fly, to run away.

m. (-यः)
Good luck, favourable fortune.
E.
इण to go, and अच् affix; happiness proceeding by it.

m. (-यः)
1 Income, revenue.
2 Gain, profit.
3 The guard of the women's apartments.
E.
आङ् before या to obtain, ड aff.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
Not offering sacrifice.
E.
अ neg. यज्ञ sacrifice.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Unfit for sacrifice.
E.
अ neg. यज्ञक sacrificial.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Not sacrificial, common, profane.
E.
अ neg. यज्ञिय sacrificial.

mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति)
Incontinent, of unsubdued appetite.
E.
अ neg. यतिन् self-restraining.

m. (-त्नः)
Absence of effort or exertion.
E.
अ neg. यत्व effort.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Idle, indifferent, making no exertion.
E.
अ neg. यत्न effort, and कारिन् who makes.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Spontaneous, readily or easily produced.
E.
अयत्न, and कृत done. So अयत्नभूत (-तः-ता-तं.)

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Idle, inactive, indifferent.
E.
अ neg. यत्नघत् active.

ind.
Unsuitably, unfitly, inconsistently, incongruously.
E.
अ neg. and यथा as, (it should be.)

mfn. (-थः-था-थं)
1 Unprofitable, useless, vain.
2 Unfit, unsuitable, incompatible.
E.
अ neg. यथा as, तथा so.

n. (-थ्यं)
Unprofitableness, unsuitableness, incompatibility.
E.
अयथातथ and ष्यञ aff.

n. (-थ्यं)
Unfitness, unsuitableness, incompatibility.
E.
अयथातथ and घ्यञ् aff.

mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं)
1 Not according to the sense or object, incongruous, nonsensical, unmeaning.
2 Improper, unfitting.
3 False, untrue.
E.
अ neg. यथा as, अर्थ sense.

ind.
Inaccurately, erroneously.
E.
अ neg. यथा as, and वति aff.

ind.
Unsuitably, imperfectly.
E.
अयथा, and वल strength.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Irreligious.
E.
अ neg. यथा according to, शास्त्र scripture, and कारिन् who acts.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Insufficient, not enough.
2 Disliked, disapproved of.
E.
अ neg. यथेष्ट wished.

n. (-नं)
1 A road, a path.
2 The half year, that is, the sun's road north and south of the equator. See उत्तरायण, &c.
3 The equinoctial and solstitial points.
4 A Śāstra or inspired writing.
E.
इण to go, and ल्युट् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Natural disposition or temperament.
2 Halt, stop.
E.
अ neg. and या to go, ल्युट् affix; what never departs.

n. (-नं)
1 The natural temperament or disposition.
2 Coming, arrival.
E.
आङ्, या to obtain, affix ल्युट्.

m. (-लः)
The interval between the equinoxes.
E.
अयन, and काल time.

m. (-गः)
See अयनांश.
E.
अयन, and भाग a part.

m. (-शः)
The arc between the vernal equinoctial point, and the beginning of the fixed zodiac or first point in Aries.
E.
अयन, and अंश a part.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unrestrained, self-willed.
E.
अ neg. यन्त्रित restrained.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Lucky, fortunate.
E.
अय and मतुप aff.

mfn. (-शाः-शाः-शः)
Infamous.
n. (-शः)
Infamy.
E.
अ neg. यशस् fame.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
Disgraceful, degrading.
E.
अयशस् and कर what makes.

mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं)
Infamous. So अयशस्विन् mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि).
E.
अयशस् and य or विनि aff.

n. (-यः)
Iron.
m. (-याः)
A name of VAHNI or fire.
E.
इण to go, and असुन् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-न्तः)
A precious stone, the loadstone.
E.
अयस् and कान्त beautiful, implying a gem, after this word and others, as सूर्य्यकान्त, &c.

m. (-रः)
1 The upper part of the thigh.
2 A blacksmith.
E.
अयस्, and कार an agent.

m. (-म्भः)
An iron pot or boiler.
E.
अयस् and कुम्भ a jar.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
One who does not ask or solicit.
E.
अ neg. याचक who solicits.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unasked, unsolicited.
m. (-तः)
The name of a Muni or saint, also उपवर्ष.
E.
अ neg. and याचित asked, solicited.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Urgently requested or desired.
E.
आङ् before याच to ask, क्त aff.

mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं)
Outcaste, degraded, not competent to offer sacrifice.
E.
अ neg. याज्य to be sacrificed; by whom.

mfn. (-र्व्वः-ब्वो-र्व्वं)
Following, subsequent to, succeeding.
E.
अ neg. यातपूर्व्व preceding.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Improper, unjust.
2 Absurd, incongruous.
E.
अयथार्थ and ठञ् aff.

n. (-र्थ्यं)
1 Impropriety, unfitness.
2 Absurdity, nonsense.
E.
अयथार्थ and य्यञ् aff.

m. (-यः)
A country.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Produced in, or brought from Ayānaya.
E.
अयानय and ख aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Unstained with lac-dye, naturally red.
E.
अ neg. यावक of lac.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Active, diligent, indefatigable.
E.
अयस् iron, शूल a sharp weapon, affix ठञ्.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Coming, approaching.
E.
आङ् before इण to go, शतृ aff.

Long.
2

Diffuse, prolix.
m. (-तः)
An oblong figure, (in geometry.)
E.
आङ् before यम to cease, affix क्त.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
Docile, tractable, dependant.
E.
आङ्, यम to restrain, and क्त aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Come.
E.
आङ् before यात gone.

f. (-दा)
The plantain tree, (Musa sapientum.)
E.
आयत long, and छद a leaf, long-leaved.

m. (-स्तूः)
A panegyrist.
E.
आयत diffuse, ष्टू to praise, and क्विप् aff.

m. (-र्द्धः)
(In geometry,) half an oblong.
E.
आयत and अर्द्ध half.

n. (-नं)
1 Abode, house.
2 An altar, also a shed for sacrifices.
3 A ground plot, the site of a house, &c.
4 The cause of disease.
E.
आयत nominal root, to lengthen, affix ल्युट्; extending from the house.

f. (-क्षी)
A woman with large eyes or long eyelids.
E.
आयत and अक्षि the eye, fem. affix ङीप्.

f. (-तिः)
Long continuance, remote futurity.
E.
आयत and आयति future time.

f. (-तिः)
1 Future time.
2 Majesty, dignity.
3 Restraint of mind.
4

Length.
5

Meeting, junction.
6 Obtaining.
E.
आङ्, यम to cease, affix क्तिन्.

f. (-त्तिः)
1 A day.
2

Affection.
3

Subjection, subjecting.
4 A boundary, a limit.
5 Power, strength.
6 Continuance in the right way, steadiness of conduct.
7

Sleeping.
8

Length.
9

Majesty, dignity.
10 Future time.
E.
आङ्, यति to endeavour, and क्तिन् aff.

mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्)
1 Long, extended.
2 Stately, dignified.
3 Self-restrained.
E.
आयति and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Long-eyed, having large eyes.
E.
आयत and ईक्षण sight.

f. (-ता)
1 Docility, tractableness, humility.
E.
आयत्त and तल् affix of the abstract; also with त्व, आयत्तत्वं.

ind.
Having restrained or suppressed.
E.
आङ् before यम to restrain, ल्यप् aff.

m. (-यः)
Receipt and disbursement, income and expenditure.
E.
आय and व्यय expense.

n. (-कं)
Missing, regretting.

mfn. (-सः-सी-सं)
1 Of iron, iron.
2 Armed with an iron weapon.
3 Zealous.
n. (-सं)
1

Iron.
2

A weapon.
f. (-सी)
Armour for the body, a breast-plate, a coat of mail.
E.
अयस् iron, अण् and ङीप् affs.

m. (-सः)
1 Fatigue, weariness.
2 Effort, exertion.
3 Trouble, labour.
E.
आङ् before यस to endeavour, to make exertion, and घञ् aff.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
1 Sharpened, whetted.
2 Thrown, cast, sent.
3 Pained, distressed.
4 Vexed, angry.
5 Hurt, killed.
6 Managed or effected with difficulty.
7 Labouring, toiling, making effort or exertion.
E.
आङ्, यस to endeavour, क्त aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Obtained by sacrifice.
E.
आङ् before याग sacrifice, भूत become.

m. (-मः)
1 Length, either in space or time.
2 Breadth, (in mensuration.)
3 Restraint, restraining.
E.
आङ् before यम to cease, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
1 Long in space or time.
2 One who restrains.
E.
आयाम and इनि affix or आङ् before यम and घिनुण् aff.

mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि)
1 Making exertion, active, laborious.
2 Exhausted by labour, wearied.
E.
आङ्, यस to endeavour, घिनुण् aff.
